name: CodeWords
description:
CodeWords lets you build, deploy, and run automation workflows and websites
directly from conversation. Describe what you want to automate or build,
and CodeWords handles the rest - writing the code, connecting your services,
deploying to the cloud, and scheduling runs. Build full-stack web apps
deployed to your own URL, or backend automations that connect to Slack,
Gmail, Notion, and hundreds of other services.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CodeWords to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CodeWords to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://runtime.codewords.ai/run/devx_mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CodeWords MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CodeWords lists 20 MCP tools, including consult_docs, search_templates, edit_service, deploy_service, validate_service, run_code, get_workflow_requests, get_workflow_logs, get_workflow_output, cancel_workflow, list_user_secrets, and get_user_secret.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CodeWords?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CodeWords in automation-workflows on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sidewave Maggiordomo, Corsair Cloud, Fleet Workspace, Whalesync, and typenode-mcp.
CodeWords requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CodeWords is developed by Agemo. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
